To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
AmritaRITE is a scalable model that is effective in improving the teaching and learning outcomes in rural areas.
AmritaRITE has a strong impact on teachers’ knowledge, attitudes and practices.
the use of mobile learning technology in teacher training can improve the quality of teaching and learning outcomes in rural education.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the impact of technology enabled teacher training on the quality of rural education in India.
the development of an innovative, technology enabled teacher training program for low literate remote and rural multi-grade education centers.
the development and implementation of a comprehensive teacher training program that will enable teachers to teach effectively in rural, low electricity and low connectivity environments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Amrita RITE Program has been successful in improving the teaching skills of the participating teachers, and in improving the quality of education imparted in the participating MGCs, in terms of student achievement in the learning of the three subjects of reading, writing, and mathematics.

the AmritaRITE program has been successful in improving the quality of education in the multi grade education centers, in the rural areas, and in the process of improving the quality of the education, the teachers and the community have also been positively affected.

the AmritaRITE program has the potential to transform rural education in India and beyond, by training teachers as change agents and influencing both children and communities, and bringing about sustainable change in education attitudes, teaching methodologies and subject matter expertise.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the program aims at improving the teaching and learning environment in rural schools, and in turn improving the quality of learning outcomes of children.
AmritaRITE aims at training teachers to teach effectively in a tablet based environment, in order to enable them to improve student learning outcomes.

we have trained 1000 teachers and 5000 students, with 100% pass rate in the state board exams, 80% of students are now enrolled in higher education, 80% students now have a positive attitude towards education, and 100% of teachers have been trained on how to use the tablets for their teaching and 100% have started using them.
The main takeaway from our work is that
teachers can be trained to be change agents, and can be empowered with technology to influence both children and community, and bring about sustainable change.
technology enabled training of teachers can improve learning and teaching outcomes in rural areas.
technology can play a key role in improving quality of education in remote areas, and can be used to improve teacher training.
